decisions.statement: A title matching no song is filed as a song of the artist the release names.
A song filed this way is titled the composition rather than the release title.
Two titles reducing to one composition are filed as one song.
A song filed this way is performed, because Alan holds a recording of it.
A song filed this way states no external record.
A song filed this way states no song type.
No song is filed under an artist who has no page.
A title holding no letter and no digit is filed as no song.
Nothing here writes over a song already filed.

definition: the song a released title is filed as where no song is filed yet
